clauses.reason: EO 13138 section 3 revokes the orders listed there, which established committees that "have terminated and whose work is completed", and item (b) lists EO 13038 "as amended by section" 5 of EO 13062 and Executive Orders 13065, 13081, and 13102. That names this order. Its section 9 states "This order shall be effective September 30, 1999.", so the first end is 1999-09-30. The two amendments of section 1 of EO 13038 continued until the parent was revoked.

research_rationale:
EO 13065 (signed 1997-10-22; 62 FR 55329, Federal Register of 1997-10-24, FR Doc. 97-28427) was read in full in the held Federal Register text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_13065.txt. It is one paragraph that amends section 1 of EO 13038 (Advisory Committee on Public Interest Obligations of Digital Television Broadcasters), as amended by section 5 of EO 13062, by replacing the member limit with "up to 25" and adding Co-Chairs. First end: EO 13138 (signed 1999-09-30; 64 FR 53879, Federal Register of 1999-10-04), section 3(b), revokes EO 13038 "as amended by section" 5 of EO 13062 and Executive Orders 13065, 13081, and 13102, among orders that established committees that "have terminated and whose work is completed"; its section 9 makes the order effective September 30, 1999. EO 13138 names this order. Later event: EO 13081 (signed 1998-04-30) moved the parent's reporting date from June 1, 1998 to October 1, 1998 and so postponed the committee's own termination. The parent's section 4 ("The Committee shall terminate 30 days after submitting" its report, unless extended) is an earlier candidate: no held source gives the report date or the date the committee actually terminated, so it is disclosed as a spent fact and the order stays on the books until the express revocation. The held text is the machine-extracted text layer of the official Federal Register PDF; the PDF page images are not held, so identity (printed number, title, signing date and FR Doc. number) was checked on the text layer against the census register row.
